reviewer: Codex visual inspection; development review, not an expert solar-physics endorsement
selection_method: Worst, median and best physical-image calibration PQ among observations with at least three annotated instances; first annotator shown; crop centered on its largest instance.
observations: Predictions follow visible dark structures in the reviewed crops; no all-sun or off-disk mask collapse.
The worst case fragments and misses a faint curved structure.
The median case truncates a long faint filament and includes an additional small detection.
The best case preserves an elongated curved filament and a small neighboring instance.
Held-out large instances have the weakest size-bin recall (12 of 37 annotated comparisons), supporting longer-context and instance-grouping work.
limitations: Three displayed crops are a systematic qualitative sample, not an exhaustive morphological review. Known errors are acceptable for the declared first-baseline operational gate; more work is needed for competitive performance.
